messages.subject: StanCon Submissions Update
parts:
Dear Stan users, 

Responses just went out to everyone who submitted a notebook/talk to StanCon. Thank you to everyone who submitted! 

If you made an official submission (and received confirmation of your submission several weeks ago, most likely from me) but did not receive a follow up email today, please let us know in an email to sta...@mc-stan.org.

Jonah
(on behalf of the StanCon Organizing Committee)
